data.name: Hafeesh
data.gender_notes: Hafeesh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hafeesh comes from the Arabic word 'hafa' which means 'to release' or 'to free'. This name signifies liberation and freedom from all kinds of hardships and difficulties. It is also a spiritual name which signifies the freeing of the soul from the material world and its attachment to the Divine. The name Hafeesh carries the meaning “Freedom, Liberation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hafeesh usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom, liberation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
